WITH wfps_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        upkeeprobot,
        SUM(faultpredscore * (1.0 / (1 + upkeepduedays))) / SUM(1.0 / (1 + upkeepduedays)) AS wfps
    FROM maintenance_and_fault
    GROUP BY upkeeprobot
),
mrul_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        upkeeprobot,
        MIN(rulhours) AS mrul
    FROM maintenance_and_fault
    GROUP BY upkeeprobot
),
toh_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        operbotdetref,
        MAX(totopshrval) AS toh
    FROM operation
    GROUP BY operbotdetref
),
no_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        operbotdetref,
        COUNT(*) AS no
    FROM operation
    GROUP BY operbotdetref
)
SELECT 
    rd.botdetreg AS robot_id,
    ROUND(CAST(w.wfps AS numeric), 4) AS predicted_failure_risk,
    m.mrul AS minimum_remaining_useful_life,
    t.toh AS total_operating_hours,
    n.no AS number_of_operations,
    CASE 
        WHEN w.wfps > 0.6 AND m.mrul < 500 THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN w.wfps > 0.4 OR m.mrul < 500 THEN 'WARNING'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS maintenance_priority_level
FROM robot_details rd
JOIN wfps_calc w ON rd.botdetreg = w.upkeeprobot
JOIN mrul_calc m ON rd.botdetreg = m.upkeeprobot
JOIN toh_calc t ON rd.botdetreg = t.operbotdetref
JOIN no_calc n ON rd.botdetreg = n.operbotdetref
